config_files.body:
import Lake
open Lake DSL

/-! CM-T02 leaf verification configuration, SOURCE ONLY.
No dependency packages are resolved by this leaf. The admitted external
object roots are supplied by the existing desktop runner's frozen LEAN_PATH.
This script subsumes the four serial elaborations; do not run them twice.
The outer owner-admitted runner must enforce limits and supervise descendants.
-/
package cmT02Desktop

@[test_driver]
script verify (args) do
  unless args.isEmpty do
    IO.eprintln "CM-T02 accepts no additional targets or arguments."
    return 64
  let workspace ← getWorkspace
  unless workspace.dir.toString == "/home/astra/codex-workspaces/cm-t02-desktop-20261015-01" do
    IO.eprintln "CM-T02 workspace differs from the reserved root."
    return 64
  let searchPathOption ← IO.getEnv "LEAN_PATH"
  let searchPath := searchPathOption.getD ""
  if searchPath.isEmpty then
    IO.eprintln "CM-T02 refuses an empty LEAN_PATH."
    return 64
  for name in #["CMSparseSupplier", "CMFoundations", "CMSeparation", "CMInterfaceAudit"] do
    let child ← IO.Process.spawn {
      cmd := "/home/astra/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.33.1/bin/lean"
      args := #[s!"--root={workspace.dir / "source"}", "--threads=1",
        "-o", (workspace.dir / "build" / s!"{name}.olean").toString,
        "-i", (workspace.dir / "build" / s!"{name}.ilean").toString,
        (workspace.dir / "source" / s!"{name}.lean").toString]
      cwd := some (workspace.dir / "source")
      stdout := .inherit
      stderr := .inherit
    }
    let code ← child.wait
    unless code == 0 do
      return code
  return 0
